QuestInfo.name: A Mission in Henesys
QuestInfo.0: I have finally reached the level it takes to receive an assignment as a Cygnus Knight. I'll need to visit #bthe Tactician for Cygnus Knights, #p1101002##k for an assignment.
QuestInfo.1:
You finally receive the first assignment from #p1101002#, asking that you head over to #b#m100000000# of Victoria Island#k and provide support for #bAgent #p1103001##k. In order to get to Henesys, you must...

1. Go to the Sky Ferry and take the ship that heads to Victoria Island.
2. Arrive at the Victoria Tree Platform.
3. Go toward Henesys from the Six-Way Crossroads.

...Be careful not to get lost.
QuestInfo.2: I finally received the first assignment from #p1101002#, asking that I head over to #m100000000# of Victoria Island and provide support for Agent #p1103001#. I guess this kind of assignment is very common, since the Cygnus Knights are sent to different parts of Maple World to collect information on the Black Mage.

0.0: I see that you have reached Level 13. Okay, from here on out, as an official member of Cygnus Knights, you will receive official assignments that will be given to you from the headquarters. Do you want to know what your duties are? Let me explain them.
0.1: Your duties, your assignments are detailed tasks given to you to fulfill as a member of the Cygnus Knights. That's because if one person takes on all of the duties, such as strengthening one's self, while at the same time investigating Black Mage and preventing his warriors from invading, that person will burn out in no time.
0.2: We have delegated the duties for a more effective way of facing the Black Mage and his warriors. Everyone presents different but appropriate sets of skills depending on the circumstances, and this is a way of doing that.
0.3: The duty that most suits you at this point is... #bworking in #m100000000##k. Since you'll be sent there for your duties, you will be away from Ereve for the forseeable future. If you have some unfinished business to take care of, then you should take care of it right now. If you are ready to take on the tasks immediately, then press Accept.

yes.0: Head over to #m100000000#, where you'll run into #bAgent #p1103001##k, who's there to gather up information on the Black Mage. Secrecy is of utmost importance as an Agent, so you won't be able to find him easily. Your first task is to contact him.
yes.1: Hey, do you know how to get to #m100000000#? Henesys is located on Victoria Island. If you take the #bPortal on top of the steps of the Crossroads of Ereve#k and go to the #bSky Ferry#k, you will see an Airship. You can go to Victoria Island by talking to #bKiriru#k, and then taking the ship that is headed toward #bVictoria Tree Platform#k.
yes.2: Ellinia is not too far from Henesys... Make sure you check the Henesys Portal before going.
yes.3: Find Roca when you reach Henesys. He'll give you your mission. Oh, and don't forget to ask #p1101001# for a blessing on your way out. Best of luck to you!

no.0: If you have some unfinished business to take care of in Ereve, do so now before taking on the assignment.

1.0: Are you an agent from Ereve by any chance? Wow, it's nice to see you! It's been such a long time since I last met anyone from the Cygnus Knights. How's Ereve? Is Oz still the same old? Ahhh... I must be really missing Ereve if I am admitting to missing #p1101002#...!

npc.0: The agent in charge of #b#m100000000##k is #b#p1103001##k. He's either hiding himself somewhere in #m100000000#, or others. Your first duty is to find that wrestler.
